name: Couch Park Cucumber Tree
access: Free. Southeast corner of Couch Park, a public city park (the park adjoins the Metropolitan Learning Center school; the tree is on park grounds).
transport: TriMet bus service along NW Glisan/23rd; exact stop not verified.
verify_notes: Register (Portland Parks heritage tree, designated 1994): 100 ft tall, 55 ft spread, 59 in diameter, 17.4 ft circumference. Portland Parks' own page gives different dimensions (93 ft, 63 ft spread, 44 in, 15.35 ft circumference); both given, not reconciled. Register note: 'perhaps the largest Cucumber Tree in the city'. Planted around 1900 on the estate of Cicero Horatius Lewis, who owned the only house ever built on the block (1879-80); house razed 1917 to make way for the park attached to Couch School (now Metropolitan Learning Center). Age ~125 follows from the register's 'planted around 1900' for THIS tree. Alive: lifecheck RECENT, iNaturalist obs 2026-05-09 (https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/359944032). Pin: register tree-level coordinate (8 decimals), not separately checked against aerial. Cucumber tree is a magnolia native to eastern US, rare this far west.

verify_notes: Register only (designated 2004): 166 ft tall (about 50 m), 56 ft spread, 71 in diameter, 18.8 ft circumference. Register note: 'located along the Cedar Grove Trail in Powell Butte Nature Park.' Register coordinate has only 4 decimals (about 10 m), so approximate; the trail location is the honest direction. Alive: lifecheck RECENT, iNaturalist obs 2026-03-22 (https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/344523182) near the coordinate. Second Powell Butte tree already published (ptl_012, Lombardy poplar).
